## Who we help

- B2B companies that need premium web development: a company site or landing page
- Teams searching for the best website developers in Kerala
- Teams that need a web application: portal, dashboard, or internal tool
- Companies that need AI SEO so Google, ChatGPT, and Perplexity can cite the site

## Offer

- Premium web development: ₹20,000 for Home, About, and Enquiry. Extra pages priced in the calculator with no cap (₹22,000 / ₹23,500 / ₹25,000 then +₹1,500 per page). Next.js on Vercel, no WordPress, no maintenance retainer. Source and repo handed over. AI SEO included.
- Web applications: ₹1–1.5 lakh INR. Next.js, Node APIs, PostgreSQL, Supabase Auth, dashboards, portals, light automation.
- Custom platforms: quoted. Multi-user systems, WebSockets, Python, RAG, Gemini/Mistral, realtime voice, custom models.
- AI SEO: schema, llms.txt, entity markup, and fast Next.js for Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews. Included with website engineering. No separate retainer.

## Stack

- Frontend: Next.js, React, HTML/CSS, responsive UI, Plotly
- Backend: Node.js, Next.js route handlers, Python, WebSockets, REST APIs, webhooks
- Data: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Supabase Auth, OTP auth, session/cache
- Cloud: Vercel, Supabase Cloud, VPS
- AI (platforms): Mistral, Gemini, Gemini Live, OpenAI Realtime, Ultravox, speech-to-speech, RAG, fine-tuning
- AI SEO: JSON-LD, FAQ schema, llms.txt, sitemaps, canonical URLs
